definitions.gloss: appraisal certificate; expert evaluation document; authentication certificate
definitions.explanation: An official document produced by a qualified expert that certifies the value, authenticity, or quality of an item. Used for jewelry, art, real estate, and forensic evidence.

examples.japanese: {鑑定書|かんていしょ}{付|つ}きのダイヤモンドだ。
examples.english: This is a diamond with an appraisal certificate.

examples.japanese: {不動産|ふどうさん}の{鑑定書|かんていしょ}を{依頼|いらい}した。
examples.english: I requested a real estate appraisal certificate.

examples.japanese: この{絵画|かいが}は{専門家|せんもんか}の{鑑定書|かんていしょ}があるので、{本物|ほんもの}であることが{証明|しょうめい}されている。
examples.english: This painting has an expert's appraisal certificate, so its authenticity is proven.

notes:
Composed of {鑑定|かんてい} (appraisal, expert evaluation) and {書|しょ} (document). A {鑑定書|かんていしょ} carries professional authority — it is issued by a certified appraiser or expert and serves as proof of an item's value, quality, or authenticity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鑑定書|かんていしょ}{付|つ}き: with an appraisal certificate
- {鑑定書|かんていしょ}を{発行|はっこう}する: to issue an appraisal certificate
- {鑑定書|かんていしょ}を{依頼|いらい}する: to request an appraisal
- {宝石|ほうせき}の{鑑定書|かんていしょ}: gemstone appraisal certificate
- DNA{鑑定書|かんていしょ}: DNA test report

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鑑別書|かんべつしょ}: identification certificate — certifies what something is (e.g., type of gemstone) but not its grade or value
- {証明書|しょうめいしょ}: certificate, proof — a general term for any official certificate
- {鑑定|かんてい}: appraisal — the act of appraising, without reference to the document itself
